expectation: Membrane ring on a subset of immune cells (memory/activated T cells, some myeloid), a minority of tissue cells. They should sit in lymphoid aggregates or stromal infiltrates as clusters, mostly overlapping CD3+ cells, sparse in tumour or epithelium.
observed: A: yellow is patchy and varies by core, concentrated in dense cellular zones and absent from dark or empty regions. B and C: sparse discrete membranous cells, with the blue nuclear areas unstained. D: crisp ring-like membrane outlines on clustered cells. E: CD45RO lies mostly on a subset of CD3 cells (white), with some CD3-negative cells and CD3-only cells.
why: Membrane-localised signal marks a distinct clustered immune subset that overlaps CD3 cells and is absent from nucleus-dense tissue, as expected for CD45RO.
notes: CD45RO shows membrane-outlined cells in immune aggregates. They partly overlap CD3 (white in E3) and are sparse in tissue-dense fields B and C, so the stain is specific rather than diffuse haze.
